declarations.description:
Clamps its text to a number of lines and ends it with an ellipsis. The line count is the CSS variable
`--c2-truncate__content--line-clamp` (3 by default, `1` for a single line), so it can change per breakpoint.

The element measures whether the text actually overflows, and `expandable` then adds a "Show more" / "Show less"
button. Text that fits is left alone. The full text always stays in the accessibility tree; only its rendering is
clamped. Whether it is clamped right now is the `truncated` property, the `truncation-change` event and the custom
state `c2-truncate:state(truncated)`.
declarations.name: Truncate

cssProperties.description: Number of visible lines while collapsed.
cssProperties.name: --c2-truncate__content--line-clamp

cssParts.description: The clamped text container wrapping the default slot; the clamp applies to the text assigned to it.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: The "Show more" / "Show less" button, rendered when `expandable` is set and the text overflows.
cssParts.name: toggle

members.name: expandable
members.description: Adds a "Show more" / "Show less" button when the text overflows its clamp.

members.name: expanded
members.description: Shows the whole text. The button sets it; set it yourself to open or close the text programmatically.

members.name: moreLabel
members.description: Label of the button while collapsed.

members.name: lessLabel
members.description: Label of the button while expanded.

members.name: truncated
members.description: Whether the text overflows its clamp, i.e. there is more to show than the collapsed lines. Read-only.

members.name: measure
members.description:
The clamp hides the overflow, so overflowing text has a scroll height taller than its box. While expanded the clamp
is put back for the duration of the read: both class changes happen before the next paint, so nothing flickers.

events.name: truncation-change
events.description: Fired when the text starts or stops overflowing its clamp; `detail` is the new `truncated` value.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired after `expanded` changes from the button (`newState` is `open` or `closed`).
